integrity: A mathematical argument and reproducible finite cross-checks are included. This is a self-review only and does not assert independent or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Proof applies to the complete graph on an odd number of labeled vertices and one-edge flip preserving maximum matching cardinality. No statement is made for general graphs or geometric noncrossing restrictions. Novelty cannot be guaranteed against differently indexed sources; geodesic comparisons to related 2-edge flip graphs do not establish this claim. Computational verification covers sizes 3 through 11; the unrestricted theorem uses a separate proof.
title: Exact distance enumerator for one-edge flips of almost-perfect matchings in odd complete graphs
